components.description: A reported pouring control strategy in which the held cup is manipulated via x and y displacement together with rotation.
components.grounding_note: The source supports a task control interface/action space description, but the offered class paf:PouringStrategy carries additional restrictions not established by the passage.

source_support.exact_quote:
PourWater Pour a cup of water into a target cup. The agent directly controls the position and rotation
of the cup at hand. Specifically, the action space of the agent is a vector a = (dx , dy , dθ ), representing
the displacement of the cup in the x, y dimension and its rotation around its geometric center. The
reward is the fraction of water that is successfully poured into the target cup.

passages.text:
Fluids can naturally be modeled in a particle system, as detailed in [42]; specifically, a constant
density constraint is applied to each particle to enforce the incompressibility of the fluid. For each
particle, the constant density constraint is based on the position of that particle, as well as the positions
of its neighboring particles.
